_doc.milestone: The stage the opens are logged under and b2's spending is booked under (docs/plan.md, 里程碑): M3.
_doc.purpose: What the opens are for. Each open's line in data/eval/test-access.jsonl and data/eval/e2e-test-access.jsonl states it, followed by the git commit and this file's SHA-256.
_doc.systems: The systems the session runs, from ft, b0, b1, b4 and b2; ft is required. They run in this order whatever the list's: ft, b0 and b1 on the server with the ft adapter, b4 on the server with the b4 adapter, then b2 on DeepSeek.
_doc.adapters: The adapter of each fine-tuned system configured (ft, b4): the checkpoint results/checkpoint-selection-<run>.json chose on the development set.
_doc.adapters.<system>: One adapter: its GGUF, the GGUF's SHA-256 and the selection that chose it.
_doc.adapters.<system>.gguf: The GGUF the system's llama-server loads, relative to the repository root (runs/train/<run>/gguf/checkpoint-<N>-f16.gguf).
_doc.adapters.<system>.sha256: The GGUF's SHA-256, 64 lower-case hex digits; the preflight refuses a file with another.
_doc.adapters.<system>.selection: The checkpoint selection whose chosen GGUF and SHA-256 these must be, relative to the repository root; null not to cross-check.
_doc.server: The llama-server of the local systems (research_agent.llm.server.LocalServer: -ngl 99, --jinja, 127.0.0.1, no prompt cache, one slot: scripts/run_test.py SLOTS).
_doc.server.model: The base model GGUF, relative to the repository root.
_doc.server.port: The port both servers listen on, one after the other; nothing may answer on it before a server starts.
_doc.server.ctx_size: The context size (-c): 8192, as in every M2 and M3 development run.
_doc.server.timeout_s: Seconds a server may take to print its ready line and answer /health.
_doc.server.llama_cpp_build: The build_info each server's /props must report (the development runs used b11349); null not to check it.
_doc.tokenizer: The model folder whose chat template renders the local prompts and counts the context, relative to the repository root.
_doc.b1_block_sha256_16: The SHA-256 prefix (16 hex digits) of b1's demonstrations block (research_agent.eval.systems), as every M2 and M3 b1 run recorded it; required when b1 runs.
_doc.b2.max_cost_rmb: What b2's single-step and end-to-end runs together may spend, in RMB (the M3 plan: 5); the preflight checks that the milestone's budget can take it.
_doc.e2e.seed: The seed of every task's run (42, as in the development runs).
_doc.e2e.today: The date the tasks run on, YYYY-MM-DD; null for the corpus recording date, as the development runs used.
_doc.statistics: The comparison statistics (the M3 plan, default 2).
_doc.statistics.seed: The seed of the paired and the cluster bootstrap.
_doc.comparisons: The preregistered primary comparisons, McNemar's p-values Holm-adjusted together in this order.
_doc.comparisons[].name: The comparison's name, letters, digits, '-' and '_'; results/numbers.json keys its numbers compare.test-m3.<name>.*.
_doc.comparisons[].a: The system compared: the difference is a's success rate minus b's.
_doc.comparisons[].b: The system a is compared with.
_doc.comparisons[].deferred: Only for a comparison a later milestone runs: why it is not run now.
_doc.comparisons[].p: Only for a deferred comparison: the p-value it enters Holm with (1, the conservative choice).
_doc.gpu: The GPU before and during the session (nvidia-smi).
_doc.gpu.idle_max_mib: The most GPU memory in use, in MiB, that still counts as idle at the preflight (1500, as for the overnight training).
_doc.gpu.sample_ms: The interval of the GPU sampling beside each server, in milliseconds (the plan: 200).

purpose: M3 phase 4: FT against B0, B1 and B4 (and B2 described) on the locked single-step and end-to-end test sets, as preregistered in docs/m3-预登记.md

comparisons.name: ftr-vs-b2
comparisons.deferred: FT+R, the fine-tuned model routing to B2 when unsure, is built in M4; M3 enters this comparison at p = 1 (the M3 plan, default 2)
